selection_basis: Quantity/classification is the largest remaining law gap with a frozen current e-Gov source path. B20 may add only materially distinct Class-4 table, aggregation and threshold decisions beyond B7's already-verified single-substance, mixed-quantity and basic ratio propositions.

pinpoint_scope: 消防法 第10条及び別表第一の第四類に関する該当箇所
危険物の規制に関する政令 別表第三 第四類の品名・指定数量の個別行
危険物の規制に関する政令・規則のうち数量の合算、倍数又は数量境界を直接定める該当条項
source_contract.locator_rule: Every candidate must cite one exact current e-Gov article, paragraph, table row or item that directly defines the classification, specified quantity, aggregation or threshold used. A chapter-only locator and an inferred quantity are prohibited.

planned_families: fourth-class product-name to specified-quantity decisions not already canonical
mixed-category aggregate-multiple calculations with a stated table-row basis
less-than, exactly-at and above-one-times applicability boundaries
inverse quantity decisions where one cited table row directly supplies every value
same Class-4 family comparisons only when the table rows create a material learning distinction
anti_duplication_rule: Do not recreate B1 or B7 propositions, including gasoline 200 L equals one times, direct category recall already canonical, a wording-only replacement of a mixed-multiple calculation, or a calculation whose only change is numbers drawn from the same quantity row.
